items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's with that heavy tongue in, huh, Kyle? Hmm? Your tongue a lot to get that.

ctx.x: Oh, boy, a lot when I first came here. Joe Oliver, Kimball. Well, to the truth, everybody, that fella Clem used to play like that, too. He changed a little bit. He used to play like that.
That's with that heavy tongue in, huh, Kyle? Hmm? Your tongue a lot to get that.
